render.prompt: Locked-off 35 mm very wide, static camera, no push, no zoom, no pan, one single unbroken twelve-second take from this one camera only. Start exactly from the first frame and continue the same continuous take without any cut; the camera never changes position, height or angle. The forest clearing with the tall wooden lookout tower at the left, the explorer in the khaki safari jacket and pith helmet on its platform with a brass telescope to his eye aimed at the dark trees at the right, and below in the meadow the young man in the lime-green bucket hat (soft, round-shouldered, heavy-set, washed-out grey hoodie, giant black headphones round his neck, baggy black cargo shorts, long white tube socks in black slides) sitting on the tartan picnic blanket with a sandwich in his hand, his basket and his can beside him, his back to the trees. In the first two seconds the explorer lowers the telescope, collapses it, puts it in his satchel, climbs calmly down the ladder and walks out of the frame at the left without hurrying. The young man eats his sandwich and looks at his phone. A huge brown grizzly bear with real fur and mass walks in from the dark trees at the right along the ground, crosses the meadow at an easy pace, and stops directly behind him, its shadow falling over the blanket, as he raises the sandwich for another bite. Sound: birds, the telescope clicking shut, boots on the ladder rungs, chewing, a heavy tread through grass, one low breath. Live-action documentary realism, shot on a full-frame cinema camera, natural skin and fabric, real dust and pollen in the light, subtle lens flare from the low sun, fine film grain, true-to-life colour. Late golden hour, the low sun raking across the clearing from the left, long warm shadows across the golden grass, warm rim light on the treetops. Physics: feet and paws stay on the ground, the telescope stays in the explorer's hands and then his satchel, the sandwich and the can stay where they are held or set down, whoever enters walks in along the ground, nothing floats, nothing changes size, there is exactly one tower, one telescope, one bear and one can. No text, no logos.
